english.title: Offer goods for sale as smuggled goods
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) offered goods for sale, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), as having been imported without payment of duty or as having been otherwise unlawfully imported
english.legislation: Contrary to section 87 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
offered goods for sale
as having been imported without payment of duty
or as having been otherwise unlawfully imported

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 87 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provides that the goods need not actually have been imported unlawfully or without payment of duty. The goods shall be liable to forfeiture
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant offered goods for sale, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), as having been imported without payment of duty or as having been otherwise unlawfully imported.
